notes: Shopify storefront (robots.txt: 'Shopify storefront. Public product, collection, page, blog, policy, cart, and localized HTML is crawlable', no Claude-specific disallow). Access via direct fetch of /collections/*/products.json and /sitemap_products_1.xml (no WAF/blocking encountered). Exact qty derived by exhaustively paginating /collections/all/products.json (250/page) to enumerate all 339 unique live product handles, then grouping by the Shopify 'product_type' taxonomy field. This full-catalog enumeration was cross-verified against /sitemap_products_1.xml, which lists exactly the same 339 unique /products/<handle> URLs -- confirming completeness (no hidden/unlisted products missed). The site's curated nav collections (pendant-lights-lamps, wall-lights-lamps, etc.) return lower counts when paginated directly (200/38/31/43/2 vs product_type totals of 204/41/32/42/2) because those collections are manually curated and lag behind newer catalog additions tagged with the product_type field; the product_type-based totals were used as the exact qty since they are exhaustive and self-consistent (sum of all product_type groups = 339 = total catalog size, also = sitemap count). The collections.json 'products_count' field was NOT used (known-inflated per prior batch findings, e.g. curated collections here show inflated counts up to 365 -- exceeding the actual 339-product catalog). EXCLUSIONS: (1) 'Worldwide Range' nav branch (overseas-pendant-lamps/overseas-wall-lamps/overseas-ceiling-lamps/overseas-table-lamps) is a duplicate sales-region facet, not a distinct product category -- verified by product id/handle match (e.g. product id 11545350092 'Coco Flower Pendant Lamp' appears identically in both /collections/overseas-pendant-lamps and /collections/pendant-lights-lamps); including it would double-count the same physical SKUs, so it was dropped. (2) 'Shop by Collection' nav branch (Fibre Fables, Wabi Sabi, Oxide/colour, Shadow Play, Uncork, Elements, Dori, Lantana) are curated named material/design lines, each a mixed roll-up spanning multiple lamp types (e.g. Wabi Sabi = 52 Pendant + 8 Knob + 6 Table + 3 Wall + 1 Floor) -- these crosscut the true product-type taxonomy and mirror the 'named collection/designer line' exclusion pattern, so dropped per mixed-roll-up rule to avoid double counting against the Lighting-by-Type branch. (3) product_type='Knob' (9 items, e.g. 'Galaxy Indigo Knob', confirmed via product JSON-LD category='Knob', 5x5x5cm cabinet/drawer knobs) excluded as furniture hardware. (4) product_type='Gift Cards' (1 item) excluded, not a physical product. RULE 0 gains: none needed -- no room-named categories were found to misclassify; all five lighting fixture types (Pendant/Wall/Floor/Table/Ceiling) are genuine fixture-type categories, not room categories. Company is a focused Indian lighting specialist (per brief); the only non-lighting in-scope items found were Planters (3, cement planters -- decorative accessories, in scope) and Coasters (5, cork coasters -- tableware, filed under Kitchen & Dining per scope note). No bulbs/fans/wiring found in catalog (consistent with brief's exclusion instruction; company simply doesn't sell them). No duplicate-company signal found -- Oorjaa (oorjaa.in) is a single standalone Indian lighting brand (JP Eco Design appears as an internal brand tag on some SKUs, not a separate storefront); no other prior S.N. in this project matches this domain or brand name.
